items.title: Content Management
items.description: This page outlines various ideas and initiatives related to managing content, particularly within a wiki system, focusing on automation, cross-product collaboration, and content organization.

items.title: Knowledge Management
items.description: Knowledge Management (KM) encompasses the processes and strategies used to identify, create, represent, distribute, and enable the adoption of insights and experiences. Effective KM aims to prevent Information Fragmentation, facilitate synthesis, and ensure that valuable knowledge is accessible and actionable. The process often involves organizing disparate research, capturing fleeting thoughts, and structuring information for future use.
